root_cause.text: Missing bounds check on the `addrnr` field in `rt_mt6_check()` allows a user-supplied value exceeding `IP6T_RT_HOPS`, leading to an out-of-bounds read when `rt_mt6()` indexes `rtinfo->addrs[]`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (rtinfo->addrnr > IP6T_RT_HOPS) return -EINVAL;` in `rt_mt6_check()`, and the commit message states: "rt_mt6() expects addrnr to stay within the bounds of rtinfo->addrs[]... Validate addrnr during rule installation so malformed rules are rejected before the match logic can use an out-of-range value."
